sourceProfile.license_status: upstream tree contains no LICENSE; recorded rather than fabricated
sourceProfile.shape_origin: explicit static module profile; not observed

sourceFacts: Four adaptive pools independently project64->64, resize to24x24, then concatenate before original feats.
Stage Conv biasFalse; bottleneck bias defaultsTrue; no BN inside this PSPModule.
F.upsample has omitted align_corners; no API default is invented.
Upstream repository contains no LICENSE file; its absence is explicitly retained in provenance.
sourceSemantics: recorded graph projection; imported SVG glyphs; source model not executed
